svg.aria-label: A TLS pair that survives a rebuild: 1. Restore: On create, ExternalSecret sklab-dev-tls pulls item sklab-dev-tls from 1Password into a kubernetes.io/tls Secret of the same name, then leaves it alone. 2. Issue: cert-manager issues Certificate sklab-dev-production from the letsencrypt-production ClusterIssuer and writes Secret sklab-dev-production-tls. 3. Export: PushSecret sklab-dev-tls copies tls.crt and tls.key from that Secret back into the same 1Password item, base64 encoded.
